title: Here’s Who HSBC May Tap as Its Next Chief Financial Officer
summary: HSBC Holdings Plc is set to start its search for a new chief financial officer, parsing through a pool of internal and external candidates willing and qualified to take on one of the biggest jobs in global finance. The bank is looking to replace Pam Kaur, who unexpectedly announced Thursday she would retire from the role in 2027.

title: Chief Future Officer: Mandy Fields, e.l.f. Beauty
summary: Chief Financial Officers now play a critical role in shaping corporate strategy and positioning organizations to meet future challenges. This episode profiles e.l.f. Beauty CFO Mandy Fields, who has helped lead the cosmetics company to 30 consecutive quarters of net sales growth. Bolstered by the purchase of Hailey Bieber's Rhode brand, e.l.f. now sees skincare as a path to even stronger long-term success. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Jon Ledecky Reflects on Sept. 11 and NYC Sports Scene
summary: Jon Ledecky, NHL team New York Islanders co-owner, sat down with Bloomberg's Romaine Bostick to remember the events on Sept. 11, the power of sports and more. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: JB Smoove Remembers Sept. 11, Rebuilding and More
summary: Comedian and actor JB Smoove sits down with Bloomberg's Romaine Bostick to remember the September 11 events and rebuilding efforts after wildfires. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Former NY Fed President on Remembering 9/11
summary: William Dudley discussed his experience on a diverted flight during the FAA ground stop after the 9/11 attacks. Dudley said the plane was unable to land in the U.S. and was sent to Saint John’s, Newfoundland, where passengers were kept for six days. He speaks with Romaine Bostick and Tyler Kendall on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: KBW CEO on Re-Building Manhattan After 9/11
summary: Tom Michaud describes how KBW responded in the aftermath of Sept. 11 by focusing first on helping the families of victims and then on rebuilding the firm. He speaks with Tyler Kendall Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Former NYC Deputy Mayor on Remembering 9/11
summary: Former NYC Deputy Mayor Edward Skyler reflects on the aftermath of 9/11, saying it was extremely difficult to make decisions in the wake of the tragedy. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: SL Green CFO on Lower Manhattan's Rebound After 9/11
summary: Matt DiLiberto discussed the 25-year transformation of Lower Manhattan after Sept. 11, saying the area has been “reimagined” from a largely nine-to-five financial district into a vibrant neighborhood where people live, work, study, and visit. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Wall Street Week | Venezuela’s Oil Test, Overcapacity in Renewables, Defense Tech Boom
summary: This week, while Venezuela has the oil reserves to impact global energy markets, rebuilding production will take years, billions of dollars and investor trust. And, Europe’s solar success is creating growing pains for investors, generators and power markets. Plus, can data centers turn Scotland’s wasted wind into an AI advantage? Later, a more dangerous world is pushing the Pentagon and Silicon Valley closer together, creating a new boom in defense and space technologies. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Rebuilding After 9/11, Cantor Fitzgerald's Annual Charity, Eye on Energy Markets
summary: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Former NY Fed President, Bill Dudley. Tom Michaud KBW CEO. Ed Skyler Former NYC Deputy Mayor. Matt DiLiberto, SL Green CFO. Ed Morse Hartree Partners Senior Advisor And Commodities analyst, Brandon Lutnick, Cantor Fitzgerald Chariman and Kyle Lutnick Cantor Fitzgerald Vice Chariman. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: JD.com Unit Agrees to Pay SEC $500,000 Over ‘Sham Transactions’
summary: A unit of China’s online retailer JD.com Inc. agreed to pay $500,000 to settle US Securities and Exchange Commission claims it made a series of “sham transactions” to meet revenue targets for several quarters starting in October 2022.

title: Bond Trader Whose Wrong-Way Bets Collapsed Firm Gets 16 Years
summary: A former trader at IFS Securities Inc. was ordered to serve more than 16 years in prison for unauthorized bond trades in 2019 that led to $30 million in losses and bankrupted the Chicago broker-dealer.

title: KKR Wraps Up $2.1 Billion Leveraged Loan for Integer Acquisition
summary: KKR & Co. Inc. finalized a $2.1 billion loan to help fund its pending acquisition of medical-device maker Integer Holdings Corp. after securing more-favorable terms, seizing on investor demand for leveraged-buyout financings.

title: Oraclum Hedge Fund Founder Charged With Lying About Returns
summary: Vuk Vukovic, a founder of New York hedge fund Oraclum Capital LLC, was charged by federal prosecutors with lying to investors about his fund’s performance.

title: Finding Stability in Investing: Masters in Business with Seth Bernstein
summary: Barry speaks with Seth Bernstein, Chief Executive Officer of AllianceBernstein. They discuss his tenure at JPMorgan Chase where he was managing director and global head of Managed Solutions & Strategy at J.P. Morgan Asset Management. They discuss understanding the Private Credit industry and the future of Mutual Funds as ETFs become the future of investing. Seth also discusses the importance of in-person collaboration as well as how to invest for retirement.  (Source: Bloomberg)
